interface.longDescription: Turn your 3D designs into physical parts. Inspect a model in an interactive 3D viewer, choose an available material and colour, and request live printing and shipping quotes from Slant 3D. Review order opens Hardware API to check your design and delivery details and pay through external checkout. Previewing or quoting does not charge you or start manufacturing. Quotes share the selected model with the manufacturing provider; shipping quotes also share delivery details. Printing and delivery availability depend on the design, material and destination. Operated by Burwood Ventures Ltd.
